The Pactrail principle

We don’t decide whether a wallet is trustworthy. We decide what protection the transaction needs.
01Observe

Read behavior across balances, transactions, relationships and DeFi positions.

02Compile

Convert evidence into explainable safeguards using deterministic policy rules.

03Enforce

Deploy the recommended terms as an onchain escrow agreement.

04Prove

Issue a verifiable receipt when both parties complete the pact.
